brass-bench-plaques.title: Engraved Brass Bench Plaques | Grimes Engravers Cardiff
brass-bench-plaques.description: Engraved brass memorial bench plaques from 8 x 3" to A4. Traditional fonts, Welsh or English, stainless screws included, free proof, UK delivery.
brass-bench-plaques.eyebrow: Brass · Engraved in Cardiff · UK delivery
brass-bench-plaques.intro: Brass plaques engraved for memorial, garden and club benches. Brass has the warm, traditional look most people picture on a park bench, and engraved lettering stays readable for years outdoors.
brass-bench-plaques.imageAlt: Polished brass memorial bench plaque for a couple, on a bench outside a park conservatory

points.p: Warm gold tones that suit hardwood, teak and painted benches alike, with classic fonts such as Classic Roman or Italic.
Brass naturally darkens outdoors unless it’s polished, and many families like the way it mellows. A little metal polish brings the shine back.
For an exposed or coastal spot, or if nobody will be polishing it, stainless steel stays bright with almost no care. See stainless steel plaques.

examples.t:
In loving memory of
Margaret Jones
1938 – 2024

Frank and Margaret Williams
Who loved this garden
Together always

stainless-steel-bench-plaques.title: Stainless Steel Bench Plaques | Grimes Engravers Cardiff
stainless-steel-bench-plaques.description: Engraved stainless steel memorial bench plaques that won’t rust or tarnish. Sizes from 8 x 3" to A4, Welsh or English, screws included, UK delivery.
stainless-steel-bench-plaques.eyebrow: Stainless steel · Engraved in Cardiff · UK delivery
stainless-steel-bench-plaques.intro: A modern silver plaque that won’t rust or tarnish, engraved for memorial, garden and club benches. Stainless steel needs almost no care, which makes it a good choice for exposed and coastal spots.
stainless-steel-bench-plaques.imageAlt: Stainless steel memorial plaque on a wooden bench in Roath Park, Cardiff

points.p: Stainless steel keeps its silver finish outdoors for years. An occasional wipe with warm soapy water is all it needs.
Engraved lettering stands out against the silver. Classic Roman, Modern or Engraved capitals are the easiest to read from a step or two away.
Prefer a warmer, traditional look and don’t mind it darkening with age? See brass plaques.

In loving memory of
John Davies
1940 – 2025

Sit, rest and remember
David Evans
Who loved this view

Er cof annwyl am
In loving memory of
Gwyn Roberts

pet-memorial-bench-plaques.title: Pet Memorial Bench Plaques: Dogs & Cats | Grimes Engravers
pet-memorial-bench-plaques.description: Engraved memorial bench plaques for a much-loved dog, cat or pet, in brass or stainless steel with an optional paw print. Wording ideas and free proof.
pet-memorial-bench-plaques.eyebrow: Pet memorials · Brass or stainless steel
pet-memorial-bench-plaques.intro: Remember a much-loved dog, cat or other pet with an engraved plaque on a garden bench or along a favourite walk. Brass or stainless steel, with a paw print or heart if you’d like one.
pet-memorial-bench-plaques.imageAlt: Engraved brass memorial plaque on a garden bench

points.p: A small paw print or heart above the name is a lovely touch. Choose one in the designer and it will be on your proof.
A name, a short line and the years usually look best. Fewer words mean bigger letters, so an 8 x 3" plaque is often enough.
Council bench schemes have their own rules about what a plaque can say, so check first. Take the 1-minute check.

examples.t:
In memory of Bella
who loved every
walk in this park

Paws for a moment
and remember Charlie

In loving memory of Mittens
who loved to sun herself
in this garden

memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.title: Memorial Bench Plaques for Mum & Dad | Grimes Engravers
memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.description: Engraved memorial bench plaques for a mum, dad, nan or grandad, for one person or a couple. Brass or stainless steel, Welsh or English, free proof.
memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.eyebrow: Memorial plaques · Brass or stainless steel
memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.h1: Memorial bench plaques for mum and dad
memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.intro: A bench where they loved to sit is a lovely way to remember a mum, dad, nan or grandad. We engrave brass and stainless steel plaques for one person or for a couple together.
memorial-bench-plaque-for-mum-and-dad.imageAlt: Engraved brass memorial plaque with two names and dates, photographed before fitting

points.p: Two names and dates sit comfortably on a 6 x 4" or 7 x 5" plaque, with a short line underneath.
Adding a plaque for dad next to mum’s? Send us a photo and we’ll match the metal, size and font.
Mam, Dad, Nain and Taid or Mamgu and Tadcu: we engrave Welsh wording and accents correctly, on its own or alongside English.
